phrases.rendering: premium cozy mobile-game UI asset designed to read instantly on a small phone: soft hand-painted 3D volume, bubbly rounded silhouette, storybook garden craft aesthetic, friendly and tactile without looking like candy or a plastic toy
phrases.shape: chunky rounded forms with gentle handmade asymmetry, broad readable planes, softly beveled edges, restrained botanical ornament, generous transparent breathing room, no thin fragile details
phrases.finish: painted wood, glazed ceramic, woven canvas and knitted fibers with smooth clean shading; subtle material texture only, no grain cloud, no sugar, frosting, gumdrop, candy enamel or hard toy-plastic gloss
phrases.lighting: warm diffuse key light from upper left, soft ambient occlusion in joints, one restrained highlight, and a soft compact contact shadow contained within the silhouette

negative: candy, gumdrops, lollipops, frosting, sweets or confectionery
hard plastic toy gloss or raw photorealistic 3D render
human arms, hands, fingers or gloves
fine detail that disappears at phone size
dense grain, visual noise or gritty texture
text or letters unless explicitly requested
objects touching or crossing the canvas edge
sources: Approved Cozy Garden 3D complete set in refs/art/style-sets/cozy-garden-3d
